knowledge:
- key_parameters: count=A matrix of count data where rows represent samples and columns represent taxa ;; k=The number of Dirichlet components to fit (either a single integer or a vector of integers for model comparison) ;; assign=A logical value indicating whether to return the component/class with the maximum probability instead of the full probability matrix ;; scale=A logical value in fitted() indicating whether to scale taxonomic contributions by the model homogeneity parameter theta
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: Use when analyzing microbial metagenomic count data to perform unsupervised clustering of samples into community types or supervised classification of samples into phenotypic groups based on taxonomic profiles.
- pitfalls: The input count matrix must be oriented with samples as rows and taxa as columns, which often requires transposing raw OTU tables. Cross-validation using cvdmngroup is computationally expensive and may require parallel processing.

workflows.name: unsupervised_clustering
workflows.intent: Cluster metagenomic samples into unsupervised Dirichlet components and analyze taxonomic contributions.
input: Twins.csv (comma-separated count matrix of taxa by samples)
workflows.stages: 1. Load and transpose count data to samples x taxa ;; 2. Fit Dirichlet-Multinomial models for a range of components (k) using dmn ;; 3. Select the best model using laplace, AIC, or BIC ;; 4. Extract mixture weights and sample-to-component probabilities using mixturewt and mixture ;; 5. Analyze taxonomic contributions using fitted and visualize with heatmapdmn
workflows.code:
fl <- system.file(package="DirichletMultinomial", "extdata", "Twins.csv")
count <- t(as.matrix(read.csv(fl, row.names=1)))
cnts <- log10(colSums(count))
densityplot(
    cnts, xlim=range(cnts),
    xlab="Taxon representation (log 10 count)"
)
if (full) {
    fit <- mclapply(1:7, dmn, count=count, verbose=TRUE)
    save(fit, file=file.path(tempdir(), "fit.rda"))
} else data(fit)
fit[[4]]
lplc <- sapply(fit, laplace)
plot(lplc, type="b", xlab="Number of Dirichlet Components", ylab="Model Fit")
(best <- fit[[which.min(lplc)]])
mixturewt(best)
head(mixture(best), 3)
splom(log(fitted(best)))
p0 <- fitted(fit[[1]], scale=TRUE) # scale by theta
p4 <- fitted(best, scale=TRUE)
colnames(p4) <- paste("m", 1:4, sep="")
(meandiff <- colSums(abs(p4 - as.vector(p0))))
sum(meandiff)
diff <- rowSums(abs(p4 - as.vector(p0)))
o <- order(diff, decreasing=TRUE)
cdiff <- cumsum(diff[o]) / sum(diff)
df <- cbind(Mean=p0[o], p4[o,], diff=diff[o], cdiff)
DT::datatable(df) |>
    DT::formatRound(colnames(df), digits = 4)
heatmapdmn(count, fit[[1]], best, 30)

workflows.name: generative_classification
workflows.intent: Classify metagenomic samples into phenotypic groups using supervised Dirichlet-Multinomial group models.
input: Twins.csv (comma-separated count matrix of taxa by samples)
workflows.stages: 1. Load count data and phenotypic labels ;; 2. Subset counts by phenotype using csubset ;; 3. Fit group-specific Dirichlet-Multinomial models using dmngroup ;; 4. Predict sample phenotypes using predict ;; 5. Perform cross-validation using cvdmngroup ;; 6. Evaluate classification performance using roc and plot ROC curves
workflows.code:
fl <- system.file(package="DirichletMultinomial", "extdata", "Twins.csv")
count <- t(as.matrix(read.csv(fl, row.names=1)))
fl <- system.file(package="DirichletMultinomial", "extdata", "TwinStudy.t")
pheno0 <- scan(fl)
lvls <- c("Lean", "Obese", "Overwt")
pheno <- factor(lvls[pheno0 + 1], levels=lvls)
names(pheno) <- rownames(count)
table(pheno)
counts <- lapply(levels(pheno), csubset, count, pheno)
sapply(counts, dim)
keep <- c("Lean", "Obese")
count <- count[pheno %in% keep,]
pheno <- factor(pheno[pheno %in% keep], levels=keep)
if (full) {
    bestgrp <- dmngroup(
        count, pheno, k=1:5, verbose=TRUE, mc.preschedule=FALSE
    )
    save(bestgrp, file=file.path(tempdir(), "bestgrp.rda"))
} else data(bestgrp)
bestgrp
lapply(bestgrp, mixturewt)
c(
    sapply(bestgrp, laplace),
    'Lean+Obese' = sum(sapply(bestgrp, laplace)),
    Single = laplace(best)
)
xtabs(~pheno + predict(bestgrp, count, assign=TRUE))
if (full) {
    ## full leave-one-out; expensive!
    xval <- cvdmngroup(
        nrow(count), count, c(Lean=1, Obese=3), pheno,
        verbose=TRUE, mc.preschedule=FALSE
    )
    save(xval, file=file.path(tempdir(), "xval.rda"))
} else data(xval)
bst <- roc(pheno[rownames(count)] == "Obese",
predict(bestgrp, count)[,"Obese"])
bst$Label <- "Single"
two <- roc(pheno[rownames(xval)] == "Obese", xval[,"Obese"])
two$Label <- "Two group"
both <- rbind(bst, two)
pars <- list(superpose.line=list(col=.qualitative[1:2], lwd=2))
xyplot(
    TruePostive ~ FalsePositive, group=Label, both,
    type="l", par.settings=pars,
    auto.key=list(lines=TRUE, points=FALSE, x=.6, y=.1),
    xlab="False Positive", ylab="True Positive"
)
